goals: Maintain the faithful Minecraft Java 26.2 Fabric port of Custom Portals 4.0.0 with arbitrary-frame, arbitrary-size and shape, colored intra- and inter-dimensional portals.
Preserve the accepted unrestricted-range and cross-dimensional Workbench configuration without removing or changing the enhancer, infinity, gate, or haste rune systems.
scope: Maintain the exact Canary 2 source reconstructed from frozen legacy checkpoint f0101f38c446dddaa4226450386402c63597ba7c, including the narrow Minecraft 26.2 Hud mixin compatibility correction.
Preserve portal mechanics, all 37 recipes and costs, registry and networking identifiers, the Cardinal Components key, serialized portal fields, rune content, and resource and data identities.
Retain exact accepted Canary 2 and canonical customportals.json behavior with unlimitedRange and alwaysInterdim enabled while all other established defaults remain unchanged.

exclusions: Feature additions, gameplay redesign, recipe or cost changes, serialized-format changes, and any claim that this Workbench port is an upstream release.
Minecraft deployment, runtime-slot changes, accepted physical Workbench stack changes, protected gameplay-instance access, and Test Instance Manager changes during this migration.
Dedicated-server validation and numbered runtime observations that were not actually reported.
Legacy administrative narratives, branch history, snapshots, global databases, deployment helpers, and the failed Canary 1 binary.
